 CORAM: HONOURABLE MR.JUSTICE MOHINDER PAL  Date : 29/01/2016  ORAL ORDER 1.

This is an appeal under section 377 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 against the judgment and order of sentence passed by the Presiding Officer of 5th Fast Track Court, Surat in Criminal Misc. Appeal. No.1 of 2002 dated 30.07.2007 vide which the accused has been found guilty and convicted.
However, the accused has been sentenced to undergo imprisonment till rising of the Court with fine of Rs.500/-.
The accused was convicted by the trial Court to undergo imprisonment of three months along with fine of Rs.500/-.
In appeal, learned Presiding Officer of 5th Fast Track Court reduced the sentence of imprisonment from three months to rising of the Court.

However,
fine has been maintained.
Aggrieved from this order, the present appeal has been preferred.

sentences.text: R/CR.RA/753/2007 ORDER 2.

Learned counsel representing the State has argued that in such a serious offence under the Prevention of Food Adulteration Act, the sentence of imprisonment passed by the trial Court should have been maintained.
However, reducing the sentence to rising of the Court is disproportionate to the offence committed by the accused.

3. On the other hand, learned counsel representing the accused has submitted that the reasoning given by the appellate Court is justifiable in view of the fact that the accused has faced the trial for about ten years and in this view of the situation, the present appeal is liable to be dismissed.
4. This Court has considered the submissions made by both sides.

Section 16 of the Prevention of Food Adulteration Act, 1954 reads as under:
"16. Penalties :- (1) Subject to the provisions of sub-section (1A),if any person- (a) whether by himself or by any other person on his behalf, imports into India or manufactures for sale, or stores, sells or distributes any article of food :-
(i) which is adulterated within the meaning of sub-clause (m) of clause (ia) of section 2 or misbranded within the meaning of clause (ix) of that section or the sale of which is prohibited under any provision of this Act or any rule made thereunder or by an order of the Food (Health) Authority;
(ii) other than an article of food referred to in sub-clause (i), in contravention of any of the provisions of this Act or of any rule made HC-NIC Page 2 of 3 Created On Thu Feb 04 00:51:03 IST 2016 R/CR.RA/753/2007 ORDER thereunder; or .... .... .....
.... .... .....
Provided further that if the offence is under sub-clause (ii) of clause (a) and is with respect to the contravention of any rule made under clause (a) or clause (g) of sub-section (1-A) of section23 or under clause (b) of sub- section (2) of section 24, the court may, for any adequate and special reasons to be mentioned in the judgement, impose a sentence of imprisonment for a term which may extend to three months and with fine which may extend to five hundred rupees.]
5. Perusal of the aforementioned provision shows that there is no minimum sentence prescribed in the Act.

It is, however, the discretion of the Court to reduce State Of Gujarat vs Himmatsinhb Raghunatsinh Purothit on 29 January, 2016 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/9415696/
2 the sentence keeping in view the facts and circumstances of the case.

sentences.text: Learned appellate Court has given sufficient reasons as the accused has faced the agony of trial for about ten years and has remained present in the Court from 10 a.m. to 6 p.m. during the trial.
This Court is fully in agreement with the reasoning given by the appellate Court while reducing the sentence.

Otherwise also, no useful purpose will be served since the offence pertains to the year 2004 and now we are in 2016.
6.
For the aforementioned reasons, the present appeal being devoid of any merits is dismissed.
Rule is discharged.
